div.div: حَزْنٌ Rugged (S, Msb, K) and hard (S) ground: (S, Msb, K:) or rugged high ground: (TA: [see also حَزْمٌ:]) good land, though hard, is not thus termed: (ISh:) pl. حُزُونٌ: (Msb, TA:) and ↓ حَزْنَةٌ signifies the same as حَزْنٌ: (K:) so too, as some say, does ↓ حُزُونٌ , with two dammehs; or, as others say, this is a pl. of حَزْنٌ: and you say also ↓ أَرْضٌ حَزْنِيَّةٌ [meaning the same as حَزْنٌ, or land of a rugged, or rugged and hard, or rugged and high, kind]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
